mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (easing) combined with sustained growth in GDPC1 (GDP) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic expansion, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward crossing of UNRATE below 9.5% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as lower unemployment signals stronger labor market conditions and economic resilience.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE below 9.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and sustained growth in GDPC1 indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting economic expansion, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below previous month and GDPC1 increases from previous month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation cooling) within a late-cycle expansion regime signals central bank patience, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with CPIAUCSL declines are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor demand) and falling UNRATE (lower unemployment) indicate a robust labor market, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 1.3M and UNRATE falls below 9.5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in labor market strength periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (industrial production) signals stronger supply-side activity, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in supply expansions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of HOUST above 600 units signals increased consumer demand, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in demand spikes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in RSAFS (demand for goods) during post-shock recovery periods signals stronger economic activity, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in post-shock recovery with RSAFS rises are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
